content: Use clear product titles, customer-focused bullet points, accurate product attributes, and images that explain key benefits.
Review keyword conversion and pause low-performing targets before reallocating budget toward high-intent queries.
Maintain healthy inventory coverage and plan replenishment before stock becomes constrained.
Review comparable offers and test promotions carefully while monitoring conversion rate and margin.
Complete required account information and verify payout, tax, and marketplace profile details before launching products.
Use marketplace policy guidance and escalate uncertain compliance questions to a trained human reviewer.
Review return reasons and product-page expectations to reduce avoidable customer dissatisfaction.
